summary: Tyre trades by sea with the coastlands. The kings of Tarshish and the islands bring tribute to the king in Psalm 72.

senses.definition: Land approached by sea, also its inhabitants. Ezekiel describes the islands in the sea trembling at Tyre’s fall. Isaiah calls on the distant coastlands to listen.

evidence.locator: s.v. ʾY, KAI 30.1/3 (Cyprus), also Trip. 41 (32), line 1

note: The Phoenician noun supports the two consonants. The database files the noun under אוה, whose desire words are in taavah. Egyptian jw, “island” (TLA 21940), also resembles it, but a direction of borrowing is uncertain.
